replies.author: @tysoncung
replies.text: They have not, and both sides seem happy about it. The 1843 Treaty of Maastricht settled the rest of the border and left Baarle alone because the plots were held individually and nobody could agree a line. The last unassigned parcel was only allocated in 1995. Today there are 22 Belgian enclaves and 7 Dutch counter enclaves inside them, the border runs through houses, and the front door decides which country you live in.
